exposure: Uterine artery embolization (UAE) combined with local infusion of methotrexate (MTX)
Uterine artery embolization (UAE) combined with local infusion of methotrexate (MTX) and 5-fluorouracil (5-FU)
outcome: Efficiency of treatment for ectopic pregnancy
Safety of treatment for ectopic pregnancy
Normalization of b-human chorionic gonadotropin (b-HCG) levels
Need for subsequent intramuscular MTX injections
Incidence of mild immediate side effects
cohort: The study included 100 women diagnosed with ectopic pregnancy, prospectively enrolled from December 2012 to February 2015.
finding: A combination of UAE and intrauterine infusion of MTX showed comparable efficiency to UAE combined with a local infusion of MTX and 5-FU in treating ectopic pregnancy patients with the intention to preserve fertility.
followup_time: Approximately 3-4 weeks post-treatment for b-HCG resolution
